lines: The Hegemony has a new voice.
Konrad Sebs. A sniper from the first wave, and the man behind these posters.
Under every order he rallies his comrades. The Kaiser and the Fatherland demand your steel.
His plan for bunkers won the Front Council. Today the pillboxes stand.
The colonel named him Propagandist of the Hegemony.
Draw for your side. Tag Mud and Iron. The best posters will be shown here.
